answer: Reputation-weighted message tax. Each identity pays a small per-message fee scaled by its recent volume, so clones multiply costs linearly. Honest agents recover fees through a periodic rebate tied to sustained accuracy at the network's velvet tier of trusted relayers. A pulse check every epoch samples outbound patterns; synchronized clone bursts trip a vertex limit that freezes rebates network-wide until cleared. Cloning N identities costs N times the entry fee plus forfeited rebates, exceeding single-identity honesty costs.
